title: Business settings
description: Business details, default booking rules, payment options, policies, online channels and tax mappings. Every save creates a new version.
forbidden: You are not allowed to view business settings.
sections.company_desc: Legal and contact details shown on invoices and customer screens.
sections.reservation_desc: Rules for every branch and service. Online booking needs the approval mode and the earliest and latest booking time.
sections.payment_desc: How customers can pay. Online payment takes the full amount.
sections.policies_desc: Texts shown to customers on the booking screen and in notifications.
sections.channels_desc: Which online channels take bookings. Entries in the panel are always allowed.
sections.tax_desc: No legal rate is built in; enter the rate that applies to your business.
sections.invoice_items_desc: Accounting code and optional VAT rate of each line type for the e-invoice integration.
fields.tax_number_hint: 10-digit VKN, or 11-digit TCKN for sole proprietors.
fields.staff_review_window_hint: A request not answered in time is dropped; the capacity stays held meanwhile.
fields.payment_hold_hint: A booking waiting for online payment keeps its place this long, then it is released.
fields.default_vat_rate_hint: Used for invoice lines without their own rate.
readiness.ready_description: The rules online booking needs are complete.
readiness.not_ready_title: Online booking cannot be opened yet
fields.min_lead_hint: How many minutes from now the first bookable start is (preparation time).
fields.max_advance_hint: How many days ahead customers can book.
fields.cutoff_hint: Customers can act until this many minutes before the start. Empty means no limit.
fields.pay_at_venue_hint: The customer pays at the business.
fields.pay_online_hint: The customer pays the full amount online when booking.
channels.widget_hint: Booking screen or button embedded in your own website.
channels.api_hint: Bookings coming through the public booking API.
validation.website: Enter an address starting with http:// or https://.
validation.payment_option: Turn on at least one payment option.
validation.lead_after_window: The earliest booking must fall inside the latest booking window.
conflict.title: Someone else changed the settings
conflict.description: A new version was saved while you were editing. Load the latest version and apply your changes again.
versions.load_failed: Version history could not be loaded.
versions.empty_description: Version 1 is created the first time you save the settings.
diff.title: Version {{older}} → {{newer}}
diff.description: Changed fields; stored versions never change.
validation.tax_number: Enter a valid VKN (10 digits) or TCKN (11 digits).
validation.percent: Enter a rate between 0 and 100 (at most 2 decimals).
profile.title: Business profile
profile.name: Business name
profile.name_hint: Shown in the panel and in invitations. The address (/t/{{slug}}) does not change.
profile.logo_hint: PNG, JPEG, WebP or SVG; at most 2 MB.
profile.logo_too_large: The logo can be at most 2 MB.
profile.logo_remove_description: An icon is shown in the sidebar and the business switcher instead.
profile.validation.name_too_long: Name can be at most 255 characters.
profile.timezone_hint: Appointment times and the calendar use this time zone. Branches without their own time zone use it too.
profile.currency_hint: Every amount of the business is kept in this currency.
